statement_nl: Set up the strong inductive step. Fix an arbitrary integer n >= 3 and assume as induction hypothesis that for every integer m with 2 <= m < n and every sign sequence u of length m-1, the count U_m(u) is at most E_m, with equality exactly when u is alternating. Also record the boundary conventions U_0(empty) = E_0 = 1 and U_1(empty) = E_1 = 1.
